2121737011581395310.en_summary: @cz_binance posts 👀 quoting @harleyfoote_ who describes being hacked via WhatsApp payload, with the attacker waiting 5 days to close short positions on Hyperliquid as the market reached $68k and withdrawing funds through Tornado Cash, resulting in nearly total loss of crypto holdings except $800.
2121737011581395310.zh_summary: @cz_binance發佈👀，引用@harleyfoote_描述自己透過WhatsApp負載被駭客入侵，攻擊者等待5天後在Hyperliquid關閉空頭倉位（市場達到$68k時），並透過Tornado Cash提取資金，導致加密持倉幾乎全失，只剩$800。

2121736197701595636.en_summary: @leadlagreport clarifies that JOJO.Index is the ATAC Credit-On/Credit-Off Index launched on 6/14/2021, with results before launch being backtested and hypothetical, indexes unmanaged with no fees, cannot be invested in directly, past performance does not guarantee future results, and not investment advice.
2121736197701595636.zh_summary: @leadlagreport澄清JOJO.Index是ATAC Credit-On/Credit-Off指數，於2021年6月14日推出，推出前結果為回測及假設性，指數未受管理、無費用，不能直接投資，過往表現不保證未來結果，且非投資建議。

2121736195906416829.en_summary: @leadlagreport highlights a live example of the August 2024 yen carry unwind from Jul 16 to Aug 5, where S&P 500 fell 8.41%, high yield -0.85%, long Treasuries +5.27%, and JOJO.Index +6.26% with credit-off in 3 of 4 weeks, noting it is one episode not a promise.
2121736195906416829.zh_summary: @leadlagreport強調2024年8月日圓套息平倉的實例，從7月16日至8月5日，標普500下跌8.41%，高收益債-0.85%，長期國債+5.27%，JOJO.Index +6.26%，其中3週中有4週信用關閉，並指出這只是一個事件而非承諾。

2121736175404941605.zh_summary: @PatrickMoorhead評論一集播客討論追蹤中國流氓基礎設施的容易程度，引用蘋果的Find My iPhone技術可被偽造，並建議資料中心抽查或直接購買華為雲矩陣可能更容易。
